title: Lesson 079 · Bubble Sort: Adjacent Swaps and Passes
intro: Catch up on the key A Level ideas. Complete four retrieval questions, work through the examples, then practise and explain your reasoning.

questions.prompt: Choose the model answer: Which elements does bubble sort compare?
Choose the model answer: What is placed by one ascending pass?
Choose the model answer: What does swap do?
Choose the model answer: Swap elements at indexes 0 and 1 in array [4,2,6]. Give the new array.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: Compare adjacent pairs, swapping them when out of ascending order.

blocks.title: Trace
blocks.text: One completed ascending pass places the largest remaining element at the right end of the unsorted prefix.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: Straightforward bubble sort is O(n²) worst time and O(1) extra memory; an early-exit flag can give O(n) best time.
